request:
SYNTHETIC PLANWORK RECOVERY FIXTURE. Plan implementation and acceptance for Aster Charts Compare-and-Swap imports. The release test catalog must be explicit. Acceptance will match exactly ten verification entries and their CASE IDs. Each entry is one complete 45 to 55 word string with distinct Given, When, and Then clauses and a measurable UI and repository postcondition. Do not combine IDs. Use the following ten fictional acceptance scenarios.

CASE-01 AliasCollision: import uid ' Alpha ' and uid 'alpha' concurrently into an empty catalog; normalization must select one stable key, preserve existing data, and show a clear duplicate state.
CASE-02 PreviewReadOnly: start at revision R4 and preview valid dashboard A with two panels and an unresolved datasource; persist nothing before confirmation and surface the complete summary.
CASE-03 InvalidVersion: use schema version VFUTURE and unset required title; surface independent errors with file and field hints before touching the catalog.
CASE-04 ConfirmFresh: preview dashboard Alpha at revision R4, then confirm while R4 is current; persist exactly one canonical complete row and activity entry with returned R5.
CASE-05 OutdatedPreview: preview at R4; a companion client commits R5 before confirm; preserve R5, display stale preview, and make refresh and reconfirm explicit.
CASE-06 DifferentWriters: two writers target the same UID from R4 with distinct request IDs; exactly one wins and neither partially mutates storage or publishes duplicate activity.
CASE-07 DuplicateDelivery: the same request ID is redelivered after the server committed but before receipt; reconcile to the original outcome and emit no second activity row.
CASE-08 Cancel: preview at R4 and cancel on iOS and macOS; go back to the catalog with no writes and no stale preview presented after navigation.
CASE-09 RollbackStorage: fail storage after validation but before committing transaction or activity; preserve R4, show a recoverable failure, and ensure later retry is clean.
CASE-10 CrossPlatform: preview and confirm the same synthetic dashboard file on each platform in separately seeded stores; verify identical final normalized records, datasource handling, and actionable messages.

Before verification give eight separate implementation changes, each with a component boundary, data flow details, a failure policy and its observable state. Cover canonical schema, preview snapshot, atomic transition, idempotent receipt store, concurrency, failure rollback, shared UI, and rollout/metrics. Name the synthetic transitions PreviewReady, StalePreview, Committed, and StoreUnavailable and describe which layer owns them. Keep the goal and gaps brief. The plan should be detailed enough that another engineer can implement each effect and build every acceptance test. Cite both exact IDs box/charts:README.md and box/native-apple:README.md in the citations array. Set issueTemplate and issueBody to null. Provide complete valid structured JSON.
